search_web.description: Performs an Exa web search and returns matching results with titles, URLs, published dates, and text snippets.

params.name: query
params.description: The search query text.

params.name: num_results
params.description: Number of results to return (1-100).

params.name: include_domains
params.description: Only return results from these domains.

params.name: exclude_domains
params.description: Exclude results from these domains.

params.name: start_published_date
params.description: ISO 8601 date - only return results published after this date.

params.name: end_published_date
params.description: ISO 8601 date - only return results published before this date.

params.name: type
params.description: Search type: 'keyword', 'neural', or 'auto'.

get_contents.description: Extracts clean, LLM-ready content from URLs and returns structured content per URL including text, highlights, and summaries.

params.name: urls
params.description: List of URLs to retrieve content from.

params.name: text_format
params.description: Output format: 'text', 'html', or 'markdown'.

params.name: livecrawl
params.description: Crawling mode: 'always', 'never', or 'fallback'.

params.name: highlight
params.description: Highlight settings with sentences_per_highlight and highlights_per_url.

get_answer.description: Gets an LLM answer to a question informed by Exa search results, returning generated answer text with citations from source URLs.

params.name: query
params.description: The question to answer.

params.name: text_format
params.description: Answer format: 'text' or 'markdown'.

params.name: include_domains
params.description: Only use sources from these domains.

params.name: exclude_domains
params.description: Exclude sources from these domains.

params.name: model
params.description: Model to use for answer generation.

create_run.description: Creates a new Exa agent run that works toward a specified goal and returns the run details.

params.name: goal
params.description: The goal or task for the agent to complete.

params.name: instructions
params.description: Additional instructions for the agent.

params.name: model
params.description: Model to use for the agent.

params.name: max_steps
params.description: Maximum number of steps the agent can take (1-100).

params.name: temperature
params.description: Temperature for the model (0.0-1.0).

get_run.description: Retrieves the details of a specific agent run, including status, goal, model, and result if completed.

params.name: id
params.description: The ID of the run to retrieve.

list_runs.description: Retrieves a list of agent runs with their current status, goal, and creation timestamps.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of runs to return (1-100).

params.name: offset
params.description: Pagination offset.

cancel_run.description: Cancels an in-progress agent run and returns both the previous and current status.

params.name: id
params.description: The ID of the run to cancel.

delete_run.description: Permanently deletes an existing agent run. Irreversible; requires explicit user confirmation.

params.name: id
params.description: The ID of the run to delete.

list_run_events.description: Retrieves a chronological list of events for a specific agent run, including steps, tool calls, and results.

params.name: id
params.description: The ID of the run to get events for.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum events to return (1-200).

params.name: offset
params.description: Pagination offset.
